title: The Goon Show - touring show review
transcript: the Turin production of The Goon Show which I saw at Salisbury Playhouse the gun shows a classic radio comedy I guess many of us have caught up with them through the eternal repeats on radio for extra part of the appeal is the imagination that radio allows for so it's quite a challenge to present three of Spike Milligan suits with the gun show as stage shows Apollo Theater Company get round this by making it seem that we are the audience for a studio recording of the gun show so we can continue to imagine the explosions the Falls from great heights and all the other crazy happenings this works well and the team of the Julie now McDowell Colin Elmer and Clive green would make a good stab at imitating Peter Sellers Spike Milligan and Harry cecum they're well supportive art on Capra musicians Rachel Davis and Antony coot what came home to me was just how well these shows are written yes there are some topical references that 60 years out of date but the surreal humor seems as fresh as if he was written today I laughed a lot including at the corny jokes and then there's this warmth of nostalgia for those long departed comic geniuses and for familiar characters like blue bottle and Eccles if the production is short of anything it's that sense of anarchy and spontaneity that those two wild cards sell ISM Milligan brought to the original recording so you know the corpsing and the improvisation what is genuine or not but I did see this at its first performance and I'm sure that that element will come as the cast relaxed into the show into each other's company to sum up if you want an evening of nostalgia and laugh out loud comedy I recommend you see their goon show and I give it a solid three stars if you liked this review and don't want to miss future videos please subscribe by clicking on the icon below you
